Your Ideas. A Website That Fits.

Explore My Work Let’s Talk

Meet the Designer

Hi, I’m Janekia.

I’m Janekia, the owner and web designer behind PinkkardDesign. I’m a small business owner too, so I know how much care goes into building something of your own. I love helping people bring their ideas online in a way that feels like them. My background in web development, business analysis, and quality assurance means I pay attention to the look of your website and the details that help it work smoothly. You’ll work directly with me, and there’s room to ask questions and share your ideas along the way.

When I’m not working on a website, I’m probably taking a little break with my rescue pup, Sugalite, nearby.

A Personal Approach to Your Website

Start with Your Ideas

Tell me what you’re building and who you want to reach. We can talk it through, even if your ideas are still coming together.

Create Your Look

Your brand, your style, and your voice guide the design. I’ll make sure the layout is clear and works well on phones, too.

Review & Launch

We’ll look over the site together, test the details, and get it ready for you to share.
